# Photochemistry

`jaff.physics.Photochemistry`

<!-- Generated by `python -m jaff._utils.api_docs`; do not edit. -->

Cross-section provider for photo-reactions.

Resolves per-reaction photoionisation / photodissociation / photoabsorption
cross sections from the JAFF database and the tabulated Leiden, NORAD, and
Verner data files.

## Constructor

`#!python Photochemistry(network)`



## Methods

| Method | Description |
| --- | --- |
| [`get_verner_xsec`](get_verner_xsec.md) | Query the JAFF database for the Verner photoionisation cross section. |
| [`get_custom_xsec`](get_custom_xsec.md) | Cross sections from a `.jfunc` `photoCrossSection` function. |
| [`get_xsec`](get_xsec.md) | Resolve the cross sections for a photo-reaction. |
| [`log_fallback_summary`](log_fallback_summary.md) | Log one warning listing every photoionization database fallback. |
| [`shielding`](shielding.md) | Build the symbolic shielding factor for a photo-reaction. |
